title: Preserve the public model-health and cloud budget and intent Rust contracts
goal: Vision: V-10. Restore source and behavior compatibility for external Rust consumers importing susi_core::model_health, susi_gawd_agents::cloud_budget and susi_gawd_agents::cloud_intent after f6341e91a. One unchanged external project built against 80e9926d and fails with E0432 on each import against published core. Preserve old type and callback/ledger behaviors and the paid destination. Land inside a measured reduction under Mandate 84.

reuse.searched: The original published Rust modules and tests at f6341e91a^, the paid modules from 494b070d, and the consumer receipt for the three public imports.

limitations: The failing downstream project proves source breakage, not customer incidence. Preserve quota exhaustion, settlement and failure classification in addition to type names. The two MCP imports are covered by T-CORESIZEPROTOCOL17-7.
progress: The same external Cargo library builds before and fails on all three published module paths after the move; the installed commercial sources remain available.
